Commentary.Commentary: We are back for Zimbabwe's first innings! Afghanistan's players make their way out to the middle, followed by Prince Masvaure and Kevin Kasuza. Sayed Shirzad will start with the ball. He is the only seamer in the Afghan XI.

For Zimbabwe, it's been hard work so far in this Test match. They bowled their heart out, tried their best but got nothing from this unresponsive surface. Also, they weren't too accurate and consistent with their lines to get rewarded. Adding to that, a couple of catches also went down in the morning to compound their misery. All in all, nothing much to talk about their bowling and let's hope that their batting will give us some fight. Stay tuned for their reply...

The Afghans managed four consecutive 50-plus stands, of which, one was a mammoth 307 between Shahidi and Afghan. There was a century stand as well in it, between Shahidi and Jamal, that helped Afghanistan reach close to 550. Hashmatullah eventually brought up the maiden Test double hundred for Afghanistan and that was the moment when their skipper decided to declare the innings.

It was an excellent toss to win on a batting paradise and Afghanistan utilized it to their advantage. Ibrahim Zadran started the bus upfront and drove like a professional for some time and then he passed on the steering wheel to Hashmatullah Shahidi and Asghar Afghan. Shahidi was calm and composed as he built a typical Test knock but his skipper, in contrast, batted with great intensity and punctured all the confidence of Zimbabwe. His counter-attacking century dominated Day 1 while his record partnership with Shahidi also made headlines.

What a moment for Hashmatullah Shahidi! He is leaving the field, shaking hands with every player, be it from Afghanistan or Zimbabwe. Lovely moment and a country of 40 million people will be celebrating. This knock will change the perception of Afghanistan cricket, especially in this format. Take a bow!

Overs - 33, Runs - 108, Wickets - 1, Run rate - 3.27. Those numbers are screaming themselves to tell which way the afternoon session went. It has been Afghanistan all the way despite losing Asghar Afghan. The Afghanistan skipper was adjudged lbw on the bowling of Sikandar Raza and that was the only success for Zimbabwe. The morning session was mainly about survival for Afghanistan in the first hour and then they started to gather runs in the next. Zimbabwe were brilliant in the first hour this morning! They dried out the runs and made Afghanistan work hard for every run. Victor Nyauchi once again was brilliant along with Blessing Muzarabani and then Donald Tiripano also tried his best to maintain the same tempo. Sean Williams created a couple of chances off his bowling but both went down the drain. He himself dropped the return catch to hand Hashmatullah Shahidi a life and soon after that, Kevin Kasuza dropped a sitter to give a reprieve to Asghar Afghan. This Test match has reached that stage now for the African team from where they can only hope to limit the damage. We witnessed a few deliveries spinning and also staying low and these are dangerous signs for the visitors.

Yet another wicket-less session for Afghanistan and they find themselves in a commanding position. Their overnight pair is still unseparated and they have stretched their partnership to 267 runs now. Hashmatullah Shahidi has also notched up his maiden Test ton and is showing no signs of stopping. Asghar Afghan has been reasonably quiet compared to last evening but the main thing for the 'home' team is that he is still unbeaten and can feast on the Zimbabwean bowling in the afternoon session.

Digs in a short ball on middle, Afghan top edges his pull shot and it goes behind the keeper. They take a couple of runs.
Once again Tiripano bowls a no ball. Lands it on a length and outside off, it's steered through point for a run.
Good length delivery again, on middle and leg this time, Afghan rotates his wrists and works it behind square leg for a run.
Good length ball landing around off, Asghar remains on the back foot as he pushes it to covers.
This time Shahidi reaches out for a short delivery outside off and slaps it to deep point for a single.
Short again from Donald, outside off, Shahidi allows it through.
Short and outside off, Afghan gives himself room and pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
Williams goes flatter and on off, it's defended back from the crease.
SIX! Dispatched! Williams serves it full and around off, Shahidi gives the charge this time and lofts it over the bowler's head for a maximum. His first in this knock. 250 stand is up!
A touch short and outside off, Shahidi once again goes on the back foot and strokes it to covers.
Turning back in from around off, Shahidi sticks back and defends it down.
Sliding down the leg side, Afghan works it behind square leg for a run.
Flatter and shorter on off, Asghar punches off the back foot to covers.
A slower one, full and outside off, Shahidi pushes it with soft hands to the cover fielder.
Delivers it full and closer to off, Shahidi stretches forward and blocks it back. No ball called for overstepping.
Angles in a length ball on off, Shahidi is solidly behind the line in defense.
Some movement available. A length ball landing outside off and shaping back in, Shahidi covers his stumps and leaves it alone.
Too wide outside off, on a good length, another leave by Shahidi.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Bowls it short and outside off, Shahidi leans back and allows it through.
Beauty! Turn and bounce from around off, Afghan is forward in defense but it curls past his blade. Which team will be more worried after seeing this delivery?
Flatter and shorter on middle, Afghan punches it from the back foot but it goes down on one bounce to short leg.
Gets forward to a full ball outside off and drives it to covers.

Afghan is living dangerously at the moment! Tossed up ball landing full around middle, Afghan top edges his attempted sweep but it falls safely in the deep at square leg. Two more added to the scorecard.
Too full and on middle, it's pushed back to the bowler.
Flighted delivery, full and around leg, Afghan sweeps it off the inner half to fine leg for a couple of runs.
Presses forward to a full ball and defends it with gentle hands.
Tiripano lands it on a fuller length and close to off, Shahidi defends it close to his front pad.
Fullish again, on off, Hashmatullah pushes it out to covers.
Keeps it full and on middle, Shahidi defends it back to the bowler.
Lands it full and outside off, Shahidi leans forward and drives, but finds mid off.
Fuller and on off, driven through mid off for a run.
The batsman has just watchfully blocked this out.

AERIAL...DROPPED! Tossed up ball around off, Afghan slices his attempted aerial shot over covers towards point where Kevin Kasuza drops a sitter. The batsmen cross. Two catches put down in two overs of Sean, both batsmen have a life each now.
FOUR BYES! Through the legs of Afghan. Loopy and full around leg, Afghan goes down for the slog sweep but misses. It sneaks through and reaches the fence behind.
Eases a full ball down through mid on for a single.
Flighted on off, that is defended solidly off the front foot.
Tossed up ball on middle, a bit on the shorter side, AA moves back and pushes it to mid off for a run.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and offers a straight bat in defense.
Fuller in length on off, Shahidi defends it with gentle hands to the leg side.
Shortish and on middle, helped in the gap at mid-wicket for a run.
A length ball on middle and leg, angling down, Asfghar hops back to hack it across the line but misses. The keeper also misses and it runs down to fine leg for two byes.
A yorker on off, Afghan digs it out towards mid on.
Fullish and down the leg side, Afghan tries to flick but misses and it goes off his pads to square leg.
Leans forward to a full ball and blocks it safely to end the over.
The batsman has just watchfully blocked this out.
Leans forward to a full ball and defends it to the off side.
DROPPED! Full and on middle, Shahidi hammers it back to the bowler, it's uppish but Williams fails to take the return catch. That went like a tracer bullet and Sean is lucky to not hurt himself.
FOUR! That's smashed! Full and flighted, landing around off, Shahidi goes down and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket. Showing his hidden desires, so far he was very watchful with his shot selection.
Slightly short and on off, Afghan goes back and punches it to the left of mid off for a quick run.
That is defended solidly off the front foot.
Good length ball on off, Hashmatullah defends it from the back foot.
EDGY FOUR! Tiripano delivers it on a length and wide outside off, Shahidi flirts inside the line and edges it through the gap between first slip and gully for a boundary.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and punches it towards mid off.
Fullish and on off, pushed off the front foot to the off side.
FOUR! Class written all over this cover drive! Full and outside off, Shahidi just leans into the shot and crunches it through the gap. Looking a lot at ease now.
Fullish and outside off, Shahidi drives but finds point. No ball called for overstepping!
Gets on the front foot and blocks it again to complete a maiden over from Sean Williams.
Flatter and shorter on middle, punched back to the bowler.
Floated and on middle, defended on the leg side.
Leans forward to a full ball and defends it off the inner half to the leg side.
The batsman has just blocked that from his crease.
A length ball outside off, pushed down to mid off.

HUNDRED FOR SHAHIDI! YESSSSSS, he screams in joy and takes a big leap of celebration! C'mon! What a knock! He was impeccable with his defense early on and then showed his range with the shots as well. Gets to his maiden Test century with a drive through cover-point for a couple of runs. Hashmatullah has batted with a different tempo than Afghan but it's equally valuable. A big smile on his face and Regis Chakabva, from behind the stumps, congratulates him by saying - 'Well played, man!'
Full and on middle, angling down once more, Asghar flicks it behind square leg and picks up a run.
Angling down the leg side, Asghar tries flicking but misses. There is a leg gully strategically placed as well now.

Physio comes out! The umpires have decided to take Drinks. It's been a disciplined morning from Zimbabwe. They have worked on a plan to dry out the runs and have largely succeeded, however, the wait for a breakthrough is still on. 26 runs in 12.3 overs thus far. Afghanistan, on their part, won't be too bothered as they have preserved the wickets and usually when you give the first hour to the bowling team, you get the chance to dominate in the next hour. For now, it's all about Hashmatullah Shahidi who is on 98, smelling his maiden Test hundred.

Shout for an lbw, not given! Asghar Afghan is down in pain. A length delivery on middle and leg, angling in, Afghan's movement is restricted with the keeper standing up and hence he tries to work it around from the crease. Fails to do so, is hit near the knee roll and they appeal. Nothing from the umpire, maybe going down leg. Now, Afghan is down, lying flat on the ground. Possibly, it hit him on the unprotected area near his knee.
Good length ball on off, Afghan stays on the back foot and defends it back.
Fuller length ball on middle and leg, Asghar fails to flick and it deflects off his pads to square leg.
Fuller this time, the line is on off, Shahidi is on the front foot as he pushes it back in the direction of the bowler.
Good length ball on off, angling in, Shahidi defends it close to his body and keeps it out safely on the off side.
Fuller in length on middle, moving in, Asghar plays a punchy drive down towards deepish mid on for a single. 333 for 3, the scorecard reads!
Fuller and closer to off, Shahidi closes the face of the bat and helps it to the left of mid on. Calls for a run, his partner responds and they complete it with ease. Hashmatullah moves to 98!
A real tempter there by Nyauchi! Bowls it wide outside off, on a length and holding its line, Shahidi decides not to chase it.
Victor steams in from 'round the wicket and serves a full ball on off, Shahidi drives it on the up but finds the cover fielder.
With the keeper standing up to the stumps now, Afghan doesn't have the freedom to venture out of his crease. A length ball on off, AA blocks it from the back foot to covers.
Good length ball close to off, shaping in a bit, Afghan walks forward slightly and pushes it defensively to covers.
Again Tiripano is on the shorter side outside off, Shahidi goes on the back foot and cuts it square of the wicket on the off side for a run.
Full in length on middle, angling down, Afghan clips it down to fine leg for a single. Tiripano needs to maintain the same pressure that's created so far.
Full and on off, defended off the front foot by Asghar.
FOUR! Poor delivery to begin the spell. A gentle loosener, short and wide outside off, Asghar likes it there and cracks it through point for a boundary, only the second of the day.
Donald Tiripano (12-1-45-0) comes in as the first bowling change this morning.
Well bowled! A hint of away movement as it lands it on a length outside off, Shahidi feels for it and gets beaten. Nervous 90s!
Gets forward to a full ball and pushes it to mid on. Dot.
That is defended solidly off the front foot.
Good length ball outside off, holding its line, Shahidi sticks on the back foot and pushes it late towards point.
Fuller length ball outside off, shaping in a bit, Asghar pushes it down defensively and it rolls towards mid on from the inner half. They cross for a run.

Serves it full and around off, Afghan drives it back to the bowler. Blessing collects and under-arms a throw at the striker's end. Afghan stomps his leg inside the crease as the ball misses the stumps.
Leans into the fuller length ball and drives it through covers for a couple of runs more. Onto 96 now, Shahidi.
Good length delivery outside off, holding its line, Shahidi takes his bat away from the line at the last moment.
Pitches it up and outside off, Shahidi drives it through covers and collects a couple of runs. Wants the third run, comes midway down too but his skipper sends him back. 200 stand is up!
Back of a length ball on off, Shahidi arches back and allows it through to the keeper.
Fuller length ball on off, Shahidi gets forward and pushes it with an angled bat to point.
First run from the bat of Afghan after hitting a boundary in the 92nd over. Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Afghan clips it down to fine leg for a run.
Fuller length ball on leg, Shahidi flicks but it has gone quickly to square leg. A dot ball to finish the over.
Fuller length ball on middle and off, Shahidi is solidly behind the line in defense. This stand is now 198!
Very full in length and on middle, Shahidi drives it back to the bowler who collects it and has a shy at the striker's end. Misses. HS anyway was always in.
Errs in line on this occasion and serves a length ball on leg, Shahidi helps it to square leg and runs the first run hard, completes the second also.
Back of a length ball on off, angling away, Shahidi stands a bit across in his defensive stance as he blocks it to the off side.
Fuller in length on middle and off, Shahidi has his bat down in defense.
Lovely bowling, operating in the fantastic channel. Lands it on and around off, getting the ball to straighten, Asghar hangs his defensive bat out and misses.
Fuller in length and on middle, Shahidi flicks it off the inner half to square leg for one. Moves to 90!
Beautiful delivery. Coming in with the angle and then straightening around off, Shahidi pushes inside the line and misses.
Pitches it up and outside off, Hashmatullah pushes it to covers and eyes a run, he is sent back by his partner.
Full again, on middle, Shahidi brings down a straight bat and pushes it to mid on.
Fuller in length and around off, defended off the front foot. Just 9 runs in 6.1 overs this morning so far. Zimbabwe are working on a plan to dry out the runs.
Fuller in length on off, angling in, it's defended from the back foot. Another maiden from Nyauchi.
Make it 11! A full toss this time, outside off, Afghan throws his bat at it but connects it only to send it towards mid off again.
Too full in length outside off, Afghan drives it down towards mid off. 10 dots in a row for Afghan!
Fullish and on off, pushed with an angled bat to covers.
Victor goes wide of the crease and angles in a length ball on off, Asghar defends it from the back foot. For how long can AA block?
Full in length and on off, nipping in, Afghan defends it from the crease. Some excellent line and length bowling by Zimbabwe thus far.
Good length ball outside off, another left alone by the batsman. Chakabva doesn't collect it but it rolls to Raza at first slip off his gloves.
Back of a length ball on middle and off, Shahidi leans back and lets it through again.
Almost identical to the last delivery, but this time Hashmatullah decides to allow it through to the keeper. He is only 11 short of his hundred.
Pitches it up and outside off, Shahidi doesn't try to hit it hard and just places his drive through cover-point for a couple of runs.
Fuller and on off, defended off the front foot by Shahidi.
A length delivery in the channel outside off, Shahidi allows it through..
Full in length and on off, shaping back in, Afghan brings down a straight bat in defense.
Beaten on the drive! On a length and outside off, AA tries to stroke it through covers but misses.
Another incoming delivery, from around off, Afghan tries working around but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Beautiful delivery, full and moving back in from around off, Afghan pushes it back to the bowler who tries to collect it with one hand but only manages to deflect it towards short mid-wicket.
A length ball outside off, angling in, Asghar pushes it straight back and it goes on to hit the stumps at the other end.
Play and a miss! Victor angles in a length ball around off and then gets it to hold its line, Afghan plays the original line and gets beaten.
Good length ball landing around leg and angling towards off, Shahidi stands inside the crease and defends it down.
Beaten on this occasion! Blessing pitches it up and around off, Shahidi is drawn forward to push inside the line but it nips away to beat the outside edge.
Angles across a length delivery outside off, Shahidi covers his stumps and lets it through to Chakabva.
Blessing hurls in a yorker outside off, Shahidi brings his bat down in time and digs it out from the bottom half of his bat.
Fuller and closer to off, Shahidi plays close to his body and pushes it to covers. He's loud and clear in his calling as he shouts no.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, angling across, Shahidi has nothing to do with it.
FOUR! First boundary of Day 2 and it's from the bat of none other than Asghar Afghan. He rocks back to a length delivery wide outside off and hoicks it over mid-wicket. Continues to be adventurous.
Back of a length ball on off, Asghar defends it from the back foot.
A touch short and outside off, Shahidi steers it wide of cover-point for his first run of Day 2.
No signs of movement, either in the air or off the wicket. Fuller in length on middle and off, blocked.
That is defended solidly off the front foot.

Starts with a fuller length ball outside off, Afghan drives it through covers and takes a run. The stump mic picks one of the Zimbabwean players advising the umpire to have a look at the batsmen running in the danger area.
Who will bowl from the opposite end? Victor Nyauchi it is. 14-2-73-1 are his figures so far. He bowled really well on Day 1 and his figures don't do justice to his efforts.
Good length ball, targeting the top of off, Shahidi stays on the back foot and blocks it down safely.
Pitches it up and around off, making the batsman play this time as Shahidi pushes it off his front foot to short cover.
Better line, this. Bowls it on a fuller length and just outside off, Shahidi is very watchfully, totally tuned into action, and shoulders arms.
Blessing Muzarabani is switching around the wicket now...
Identical to the last delivery, once again it's left alone. Blessing needs to take it closer to the off stump and make the batsman play.
Full in length and outside off, angling away, Shahidi allows it through to the keeper.
Starts with a back of a length ball on middle, angling down, Asghar turns it off his hips to deep backward square leg and gets running on Day 2 with a run.

Time to get underway! The Zimbabwe players are taking the field. Asghar Afghan and Hashmatullah Shahidi who are amidst a 186-run stand are in the middle today. Shahidi will be eyeing his maiden Test ton this morning. Blessing Muzarabani (19-4-43-0)to begin proceedings. Here we go...

Pitch report - Tino Mawoyo says that the conditions are a bit warmer today. Mentions that the pitch on Day 1 was drier than the last time and this morning it's looking a bit green as some of the grass has come out. Talks about the cracks on the surface but he still thinks that it's very, very good for batting. There could be a bit of a low bounce, Tino adds.

Yet another interview, this time with Prince Masvaure. The Zimbabwean opener says that they need to keep things quiet and dry out the runs this morning. Mentions that the pitch is good for batting and they expected Afghanistan to come hard at them. Tells that they are up for the challenge. Adds that for now, they will just concentrate on bowling in the right areas.

Hashmatullah Shahidi is caught up for an interview. Says that they are feeling better after the first Test match. Admits that their batting was not up to the mark then and hence they are feeling a lot better now. Adds that he is trying his best to make his innings count and make it bigger. Tells that they are trying to post a big total because the pitch will change in the next 2-3 days as it will turn and won't be easy to bat. Talks about Rashid Khan and Amir Hamza in their spin bowling ranks and hopes to do well.

The answer to the last question would be no if you're a Zimbabwe fan. They already suffered a poor and tiring day in the field and would hope for wickets in a heap this morning. The first two sessions today will shape up this Test match and let's see whether the African minnows manage to have any say on the second day. The pitch is expected to only get better for batting on Day 2, however, it might just start to offer some help to the spinners. Having said that, the second new ball is still fairly new and the touring team can use the early morning conditions to create some inroads. Let's hope for a cracking day of Test cricket. Stay with us for more...

Welcome back, folks! Afghanistan's batting got discharged in the first Test match and they needed to charge it back! So what did they do? They bought a double A battery to put their batting back to life. Double A - Asghar Afghan led a stunning batting show for the 'home' team with a fiery hundred on Day 1. His contribution along with a determined unbeaten partnership with Hashmatullah Shahidi has put the Afghans in a dominating position and we can expect them to build on the good work and aim for at least 500. Are we in for yet another batting day in Abu Dhabi?

Afghanistan hammered 120 runs in the final session and have taken firm control on this Test match. It would be all about extending their good work with the bat on Day 2 and bat Zimbabwe out of this game. Do join us at 0930 local (0530 GMT) for all the action. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Zimbabwe's bowling dipped with time! They were brilliant in the first session, claiming a couple of wickets, then they struggled a bit in the afternoon but still got a wicket. The last session was very poor as their bowlers got tired and started to lose steam. On a batting paradise, they failed to assert any control. The pacers still tried their heart out and cannot be faulted for their effort. However, their spinners were a big disappointment.

It was a combination of fire and ice as far as the association between Asghar Afghan and Hashmatullah Shahidi is concerned. The former went hammer and tongs since his arrival while the latter took time to get going. Shahidi has played a lovely anchor role in this partnership and that allowed Afghan to play his natural game. These two have now raised the best partnership for Afghanistan in Test cricket and would look to swell it further on Thursday.

Fantastic day for Afghanistan! They were under pressure after losing the first Test match and needed a good outing, particularly with the bat, to prove their credentials in this format. That's exactly what they got to redeem themselves. The coin fell in their favour and there was no hesitation in batting first. Although their opening partnership didn't last long, they went on to thread 3 back-to-back 50-plus stands. Ibrahim Zadran was the one who laid the platform upfront with his sublime knock and then the stand between Shahidi and Afghan took over.
Full, flighted, outside off, Shahidi shuffles across and covers his sticks to let this one through to the keeper. With that, IT WILL BE STUMPS ON DAY 1!
Hashmatullah Shahidi has just watchfully blocked this out.
Goes short and on middle and off, Shahidi shows the full face of the blade to keep this one out.
Short on middle, nudged to the short leg fielder.
On off and middle, fuller, eased to long on for a single.
Well fielded by the man there. Floated and around off, Asghar Afghan gets on his knees and sweeps this one to the man present at square leg, who stops the ball well.
Blessing ends with a good length delivery around off, Shahidi blocks this one to the mid on region. Only one over left to negotiate in the day for the hosts.
Around off, length, tapped to the point region.
Sends a yorker at the base of the off pole as HS does well to shuffle and dig this one out to the on side.
This length ball around off has been kept out to the mid on region by HS.
EDGY! On a fuller length and around off, Asghar Afghan looks to drive this one but the ball takes the inside edge, goes through square leg and the batters exchange ends.
Angles in a length ball on off, AA chops this one to the off side this time.
WIDE. Blessing Muzarabani goes for the bouncer on middle, Asghar Afghan ducks under this one. The umpire thinks that this is too high and so signals a wide.
A carbon copy of the previous ball. Hashmatullah Shahidi sees off the over well. Just 2 overs left for the day.
Shortish and on the pads, nudged to the leg side.
Gives it air and lands it on middle, pushed away to mid off.
On middle, clipped to square leg for a single.
Presses forward to this full delivery to block it out.
Shortish and outside off this time, AA looks to slash at this but only manages to slice thin air around him.
Sean Williams brings himself back into the attack.
Another full ball around off, Hashmatullah Shahidi plays a good looking drive but only manages to hit the stumps at the other end. A single off the over.
Length and outside off, pushed away from the body, to covers.
Fuller and on the middle pole, flicked away to fine leg for one.
Down the leg side this time, Afghan just sits under this one.
Around off, played towards point.
Length outside off, kept out.
The batsman has just blocked that from his crease.

FOUR! Brilliant shot. Looked very good to the eye. On a good length and outside off, Hashmatullah Shahidi leans into this one and creams it through extra cover. Elegance on display! 300 up for the hosts as well!
Gets his bat across and keeps this one out, solidly.
Fuller and around off, AA strokes this one through mid on and the long on fielder runs across to his left to stop the ball. One run.
Outside off, slightly short, slashed away to the point fielder.
Good length around off, AA defends this one out, to the off side.
Shortish and around off, HS ducks and lets this one through.
Around off, fuller, nudged to the on side.
Back of a length and on the body, Shahidi looks to flick but he misses and gets hit on the body.
On a good length and outside off this time, Hashmatullah Shahidi again offers no shot to this one.
Outside off, left alone.
Down the leg side, Hashmatullah Shahidi just lets this one go.

FOUR! HUNDRED FOR ASGHAR AFGHAN! A very well played knock. Came in and showed his intent right from the start and he has ensured that they finish the day on a high. Also, just the 2nd Test ton for anyone in Afghanistan Test cricket. On a good length and around off, Afghan slams this one over wide mid on to reach this milestone with a boundary.
FOUR! Moves to 97 now! Only 3 more away from a very well deserved 100! On a length and around off, Asghar Afghan thumps this one over mid-wicket and the ball goes into the ropes.
Good length and outside off this time, Afghan lofts this one over the mid off region for a brace.

Short of a length ball on middle and leg, Asghar Afghan misses his tuck away and gets hit high on the pad. An appeal, for LBW, but only from the bowler. Nothing from the umpire as this was heading down the leg side.
The batsman has just blocked that from his crease.

SIX! WHAM! The skipper went really hard at this one. He is leading from the front now. Length, and around off and middle, Asghar Afghan hoicks this one way over the deep square leg fence for a biggie. Moves into the 90s now.
On a good length and on off, tucked to the on side.
Short ball down the leg side, Hashmatullah Shahidi just ducks under this one.
Comes 'round the wicket and slants in a length ball on off, Shahidi shows the full face of the willow to defend.
Closer to the off pole and on a length, kept out nicely.
Fuller and outside off, Shahidi just leaves this one be.
Shortish around off, Shahidi pulls this one to the on side.

Mix-up but safe! A length ball outside off, Shahidi connects well with his drive this time but finds the cover fielder. He fumbles slightly, leading to a big confusion over a run. They eventually cross and it would have been tight had the bowler collected the throw well.
Edgy...safe! On a good length and outside off, Shahidi looks to drive but gets a thickish outside edge, which goes through the point region aerially but is safe. A couple of runs now.
Back of a length and around off, HS bunts it back to the bowler again.
Attacks the sticks with a length delivery around off, Hashmatullah Shahidi plays it back to the bowler.
Comes 'round the wicket and bowls a length ball around off, Shahidi looks to drive but the ball takes the inner half of the blade, goes towards mid on.
On a length and around off, pushed to the mid on region.
Victor Nyauchi (11-2-48-1) to share the new cherry from the opposite end.
Goes back of a length again but slipping down the leg side, HS looks to flick but misses. 2 runs off this one.
Good length this time, and also around middle, Shahidi prods ahead and blocks this one out.
Slightly behind the good length and around off, Shahidi keeps this one out nicely, to the off side.
Short of a length again on middle, AA flicks this one to fine leg for a single.
Short of a length ball outside off, the ball nips away after hitting the deck and goes into the keeper's mitts as Afghan looks to slash but misses.
Short and outside off, punched through cover-point for a run.
Flighted on middle, worked to mid-wicket. Dot ball to end the over.
Floated one, full and around off, Afghan drives it to covers.
Goes flat and on middle, helped towards mid-wicket, dot ball.
That is forced away but straight to the fielder, at covers.
Quicker and fuller on the pads, helped on the leg side but straight to mid-wicket.
Flatter and shorter outside off, punched to covers.
The second new ball is available now for Zimbabwe to take and they opt to take it as well. It will be Blessing Muzarabani to speed in with the new cherry. His numbers so far read 14-2-38-0.
Short and wide outside off, Shahidi goes back to cut but misses.
Turning away from around off, Shahidi pushes at it in defense and misses.
That is defended solidly off the front foot.
FOUR! Smashing shot! Short again from Raza, wide outside off, Shahidi rocks back and whacks it through point. He has been brilliant with his square cuts and scored 36 runs in that zone so far.
Gets on the front foot to a full ball and defends it back.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
FOUR! Afghan feeds on this length. It's short and on middle, immediately Asghar drops his weight on the back leg, goes down on one knee and clobbers it through square leg. The stand moves to 150!
Extra loop on this one, full and on middle, Asghar defends it back.
This time it's been properly flicked through the gap at mid-wicket for a run.
Quicker and fuller on middle, Shahidi walks forward with the flick shot but it takes the inside half and goes to square leg.
Hangs on the back foot and eases a shortish ball to short cover.
Flighted and full outside off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
Goes short and outside off, Afghan moves back and pushes it to the off side.
A soft leading edge. Full and floated on off, not turning in much, Asghar closes the face of the bat early and it takes a little leading edge. Rolls safely back to the bowler.
Tossed up ball on middle, Asghar eases it off his pads but fails to place in the gap on the leg side.
Quicker one, full and sliding down the leg side, Asghar gets a fine tickle as he tries to flick and it runs down to fine leg for a couple of runs.
Fuller and on off, worked across the line with the spin but straight to square leg.
Flighted and full on off, AA is forward in defense.
Flighted ball, landing full on off, Hashmatullah is forward as he flicks it to mid-wicket. 4 more overs left for the second new ball.
Shorter and flatter on middle, Afghan moves back and works it to the right of mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy and full on off, Afghan drives this time but once again finds the cover fielder.
Drags his length short and bowl it wide outside off, Asghar punches but finds the cover fielder.
Leans forward to a full ball and defends it to the right of the bowler.
Full and floated on middle, Asghar flicks it to mid-wicket and his partner sets off for a run. He is sent back.

DRINKS. A very productive session, yet again, for the hosts. They have added 76 runs so far and are looking to attack the Zimbabwean bowlers, who do not really have any sort of answer for the duo of Afghan and Shahidi and they have also recorded the highest stand for Afghanistan in Test cricket. If they keep motoring along this way, then they will look to finish at the 330 to 350-run mark, which at the end of Day 1, is a great total. The visitors will be hoping to tame these two, then break their stand too, so as to reduce any more damage. An exciting end to Day 1 is on the cards.

Flatter and straighter, on middle, pushed down to long on for a single.
A tossed up ball around off, turning in, once again Asghar gets forward and this time he helps it towards square leg.
Loopy full ball outside off, Asghar gets forward and across before working it to mid-wicket.
Short delivery, on middle, Shahidi goes deep inside the crease and forces it to long on for one.

Flatter and on off, once again it's blocked from the back foot.
Flatter and on off, defended off the front foot.
Leans forward and drives a full ball back to the bowler.
Fuller and on off, it's eased down through mid off for a run.
Short and wide outside off, punched through cover-point for a run.
Full and flighted on off, Afghan pushes it gently to covers for a run. At the moment, the only way to keep Asghar quiet is by having him off the strike.
Stifled appeal for a caught behind! Not given. Short and wide outside off, Shahidi tries to cut but misses. The keeper gets excited but he is the only one interested.
Misses out, we nearly had three boundaries in a row again. Too full in length around leg, Shahidi mistimes his sweep shot to short fine leg.
FOUR! The bowler overcompensates with his length and delivers it short and wide outside off, Hashmatullah rocks back and slaps it past backward point.
FOUR! Loopy full ball around leg, in fact a low full toss, Shahidi goes down on one knee and sweeps it sweetly, fine down the leg side, for a boundary.

Drags his length short again, around off, Shahidi goes back and pulls it past mid-wicket for a brace.

Quicker and flatter on middle, straightening after pitching, Shahidi defends from the back foot to mid-wicket. 15 from the over!
The batsman has just watchfully blocked this out.
Short and wide outside off, Afghan punches it through point for a run.

FOUR! Three in a row now! A fielder drops back to deep mid-wicket after the last shot and the bowler serves it full and wide outside off, Asghar pierces the cover field with his drive for a boundary. Toying with the Rhodesians, AA!
FOUR! Asghar Afghan goes again! Flighted and full, landing on leg and turning away, Afghan kneels, slogs it against the spin but still manages to hammer it over mid-wicket.
SIX! As flat as a pancake! Shorter in length and around off, Asghar launches himself into it and thumps his pull shot over mid-wicket for a maximum.
FOUR! Well put away! Shortish and around off, Hashmatullah Shahidi swivels and pulls this one with power, to the deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Loopy around off, driven towards covers now.
Tossed up around off, Shahidi blocks this one, to the off side.
Around off, played to point.
BEATEN! Wonderfully bowled. Floated around off, hits the deck and turns away from Hashmatullah Shahidi's defensive push away. Beats the outside edge and goes into the keeper's mitts.
On the middle pole, flicked to the short fine leg fielder for a very quick single. Good running.
Loopy on off, Asghar drives this one through mid off, and retains the strike for the next over, with a single.
Around off, flighted, pushed to the cover fielder.
Worked to the leg side for one.

FOUR! The 100-run stand comes up with the boundary and it has been a good one, so far. They will want to stretch this stand and finish the day strong. Shortish, outside off, cracked through point for a boundary.
On off, blocked.
Gives this one air and lands it on off, kept out off the front foot.

Shortish and on off, Afghan tucks this one to mid-wicket.
Worked through mid on for a single this time.
Tossed up outside off, HS gets on his knees and sweeps this one to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Goes on the back foot and defends this one to the point region.
Floated around off, HS prods ahead to block.
Around off, floated, Afghan looks to defend this one out but the ball takes the inside edge, hits the pad, and then rolls back to the bowler.
On the middle pole, nudged to the on side this time.
Tossed up and outside off, Afghan defends this one out.
Flat outside off, cut away towards point.
Around off, played to covers again.
Shortish and around off, punched to covers.
Flatter and full on off, Shahidi defends it by getting forward.
This time it has been worked in the gap between mid on and mid-wicket for a run.
Hangs on the back foot to a shortish ball and helps it to mid-wicket.
Flatter and on middle, helped to square leg.
On middle, flicked to mid-wicket.

FIFTY FOR SHAHIDI! A watchful knock by him and he has grown in confidence as his innings has progressed. Gets a fuller length ball outside off and drives it through covers for a couple of runs. Both batsmen should be looking for their maiden Test hundred.
Fullish and on middle and leg, helped off the pads to mid-wicket.
Angles in a full ball on off, Shahidi defends it solidly towards mid on.
Very full in length on off, Shahidi drives it down to mid on.
Good accurate bowling. Fullish and on off, Hashmatullah defends it back from the crease.
The bowler oversteps and delivers it short and wide outside off, Asghar cuts it from the bottom end of his bat to point for one. No ball called.
EDGED BUT SAFE! A length ball on off, angling away Afghan pushes inside the line as it stays low and nicks it behind. It doesn't carry to Chakabva.
BEATEN! Blessing switches to 'round the wicket and lets out a length ball outside off, holding its line, Shahidi feels for it and gets beaten.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and defends it to covers.
On a length and outside off, angling away, Hashmatullah shoulders arms.
FOUR BYES! Good length delivery down the leg side, Shahidi tries to flick and Chakabva also fails to gather it with a dive to his right. Bonus runs for Afghanistan.
Play and a miss! Short and wide outside off, Shahidi throws his bat at it but fails to connect. Remains on 49!
FIFTY FOR AFGHAN, off 64 balls. Fullish and on middle, Asghar rotates his wrists and works it behind square leg for a run. Completes his 4th half century in Test cricket.
Fullish around off, Shahidi flicks it with the angle but finds the fielder standing in front of square leg.
Victor continues from 'round the wicket even for the right-hander and bowls a short delivery wide outside off, Afghan punches it to deep cover for one.
Fuller and on middle, Shahidi tucks it in front of square leg for one.
FOUR! Put away! Short and wide outside off, Hashmatullah chases it and chops his square cut behind point for a boundary. Both batsmen on 48 now.
Good length ball on off, Shahidi defends it from the back foot.
Pitches it up and outside off, Afghan drives it square of the wicket on the off side, wants the second run but his partner sends him back.
Outside off again, left alone.
Wide outside off, no shot offered this time.
Around off, fuller, driven to covers, where the man makes a good stop there.
On a good length and around off, Shahidi looks to push at this but gets beaten.
Bouncer on middle, Shahidi ducks.

Fullish and outside off, it's once again driven to covers.
Fuller and wider outside off, driven to covers.
Wide! Another one way away from the batsman.
Wide! Victor tries to stay away from the batsman. Under pressure, he has served it way wide outside off. Asghar leaves.

FOUR! Risk pays off! The bowler spears in a very full ball on middle and off, Asghar walks across the stumps and whips it through mid-wicket, acres of space there and it happily runs away to the fence.
Fullish and outside off, Asghar drives it firmly through the line but finds extra cover this time.
Pitches it further up and outside off, Asghar this time reacts even before his brain processes a message, goes for a drive, connects also but fails to beat the cover fielder.
Sprays it wide outside off, full and inviting the batsman to chase, Afghan gets the restraining order from his brain.
Full in length on middle, angling down, Asghar works it behind square leg and retains strike with a single.
Hurls across a good length delivery in the zone outside off, Asghar sticks back inside the crease, expecting another bouncer, and eventually, he makes a leave.
A steamy bouncer, on middle and leg, Asghar ducks underneath it.
Full in length and outside off, angling away, Shahidi pushes it with gentle hands through cover-point for a single.
Another delivery in the area outside off, shaping away, Hashmatullah has nothing to do with it.
Good length ball outside off, angling away, the batsman shoulders arms.
Blessing Muzarabani (11-1-35-0) to bowl from the other end.

FOUR! Attacking intent from Asghar Afghan continues. A length delivery in the channel wide outside off, Afghan hangs on the back leg and hammers it over the mid off fielder. He gives the chase and tries to pull it back near the fence but fails.
Nyauchi varying his length, this time he bowls it near the yorker length around middle, Shahidi bunts it down to mid on for a brisk run.
Fails to put it away! Width on offer outside off, short in length, Shahidi cracks it off his back foot but finds the cover-point fielder.
Victor pulls his length back a shade angles it around off, Hashmatullah goes on the back foot and blocks it to mid-wicket.
Fuller in length and on off, Hashmatullah leans forward and defends it to the off side.
Angles in a length ball on off, Shahidi meets it with a dead-straight bat.

We're back for the final session. 31 overs left in the day's play. Can Zimbabwe get it their way? The current stand is threatening at the moment with Asghar Afghan, in particular, striking at a healthy rate. Another hour of him and Afghanistan will find themselves in an even stronger position. Victor Nyauchi (1/26) to begin proceedings.
... DAY 1, 3RD SESSION ...

Now, with the final session looming, the hosts will be looking to build on their total and will be hoping that the skipper and Shahidi combine forces and finish the day well. Whereas Zimbabwe will want to come out and break this stand and snare a couple more wickets before calling it a day. Join us shortly for the third and final session of the day at 1430 local (1030 GMT).

Ordinary bowling by the visitors as they were not able to trouble the batters out there too much. Not much purchase for the pacers and the spinners could make the ball turn, slightly. The skipper, Sean Williams used different bowlers and kept the batters guessing but apart from the one wicket, they were not really able to have a lot go their way, in this session. Burl got the wicket of Zadran, who was looking threatening, but since then the current pair has done well to negotiate proceedings until Tea.

A really good session of play for the Afghans. They have lost only one wicket and have done well to pile on the runs and have closed in on the 200-run mark, adding 104 runs in this session. Zadran and Shahidi were motoring along nicely and also stitched a 50-run stand to their name before Ibrahim, who was playing really well on 72, lost his wicket. The skipper, Afghan made his way out into the middle and was letting his intentions known as he was looking to attack whoever came his way. He had some nervy moments but along with Shahidi, they have combined to add a 50-run stand and have stayed put, until the Tea break and will be looking to turn that partnership into a big one.
Skidding down the leg side, once again Afghan fails to work it off his pads. That's it for this session, TEA ON DAY 1!
On a length and outside off, Afghan pushes it to the off side, finds covers.

Shout for an lbw, not given! With the keeper up to the stumps, Afghan's movement outside the crease is restricted. He tries to deal a length ball on middle and leg from the back foot, but fails. Gets pinged on the pads, they appeal but it's missing leg.
Not a good idea, Tiripano! The keeper is up to the stumps and he bowls a bouncer. Afghan tries to pull but misses. Chakabva does well to get his gloves up and stop it.
Good length ball on middle, the batsman uses the angle of the bowler and helps it to mid-wicket.
Fullish and around off, Asghar gets forward and defends it back.

Loopy and full around off, Shahidi leans forward and blocks it solidly to complete the over. Just around one more minute left to go and so we will be able to squeeze in one final over, before the Tea break.
Tossed up ball landing outside off, Shahidi gets forward and across with a big stride as he blocks it to covers.
Once again HS draws forward to a full ball in his half and defends it to the leg side.
Flighted and full on off, defended well off the front foot.
Slower through the air, full and on off, spinning in, Shahidi goes back and helps it to square leg.
Flatter and shorter on off, Asghar goes back and punches it down to long off for a single.
Should be the last over before Tea.
Angles in a length ball from around off, Hashmatullah is right behind the line in defense.

Time and again, the T20 instincts come out from Afghan. A very full ball on middle, Asghar clears his front leg for a big heave-ho across the line but it takes the inner half and rolls behind square leg for a run.

Shortish again, outside off, tapped down towards point for one.

Fuller in length and around off, HS is on the front foot in defense.

GEM OF A DELIVERY! Williams gives it a good loop and lands it full around off, Afghan lunges to defend but it grips and spins away to beat the outside edge. Rashid Khan will be licking his lips looking at that! Beauty to end an ordinary over.
A bit of turn but it's too wide and short outside off, Asghar forces it off his back foot, once again finds the extra cover fielder.
Flatter and on off, Afghan punches it from the back foot to extra cover.
10 minutes to Tea but if it's there to be hit, Shahidi will hit. Short and on middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for one.
Flatter and on middle, Shahidi goes back and works it on the leg side, finds square leg.
Tossed up ball on middle, Asghar gets back and helps it behind square leg for a run.
Sean Williams comes back into the attack. 7-1-25-0 so far, for him.
Identical to the last delivery, Shahidi takes his front leg forward to cover the line and his stumps as he once again lets it through to Chakabva.
Tiripano serves it on a driving length outside off, trying to lure the batsman, Hashmatullah is not falling for it as he makes a leave.
FOUR! Punished! Tiripano goes short but this time the line is outside off, Shahidi reaches out for it and cuts it superbly past point for a boundary. Easy pickings.
Tiripano goes fuller and puts it in the area outside off, Shahidi is half-forward as he defends it to the off side.
A touch short and on top of off, once again Shahidi is behind the line as he blocks it from the back foot.
Good length ball on off, angling in, from 'round the wicket, Shahidi defends it from the back foot.
Flatter again, on middle and leg, flicked away through square leg for a single.
On the middle pole, nudged to the short leg fielder.
Flatter around middle, bunted to the right of the bowler this time, who half-stops the ball and the ball trickles through towards mid on. The batters sneak in a run.
Short and around off, pushed to the left of the bowler.

FOUR! Fifty stand is up in 70 balls. Full and flighted around leg, Afghan sweeps it firmly down to fine leg for a boundary. Third 50-plus stand in a row for Afghanistan and they would be hoping that this one goes on to cross the 100-run mark.
Tossed up ball landing around leg, Afghan works it on the leg side and it drops just in front of short leg.
Fuller in length and around leg, Shahidi brings his bat in front of the pads as he defends it back.
Fuller in length and wide outside off, Shahidi has an easy leave on this occasion.
Shortish length ball outside off, Shahidi punches it from the back foot to covers.
Fetches a short ball from wide outside off and pulls it all along the ground through square leg. Three taken. That looked more like a Tennis forehand.
Quicker delivery, full and angling down the leg side, Afghan fails to flick and it goes off his pads to square leg.

Fuller in length around off, it's helped towards square leg and they cross for a run. The fielder has a needless shy at the striker's end, well away from the keeper and an overthrow is also taken. The replays show that it came off Asghar's gloves. He is in some pain and the physio is out.
A leg spinner down the leg side, Shahidi has no chance of flicking it and it further spins down to beat Chakabva also. The slip fielder chases it down and the batsmen collect a couple of byes.
Floated and full on off, Afghan drives it past the diving short extra cover fielder for a run down at long off.
Misses out, Afghan! Short and wide outside off, Asghar cuts it from the back foot but finds point.
FOUR! Afghan is dealing in boundaries at the moment. A leg spinner dropping it short is a usual slight, it's around middle and pulled to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
A low full toss dipping around leg, Shahidi goes down and sweeps it to fine leg for a run. This partnership moves to 37 off 58 balls.
Fuller in length on off, Shahidi whips it across the line but finds the mid-wicket fielder.

Tiripano goes for a searing yorker but ends up serving a full toss on middle, Asghar is not ready for it and hence only keeps it out to square leg. Would have tonked it out of the stadium had he read it early.
TOP EDGE...FOUR! Slower bouncer attempted by Tiripano, Afghan tries his best to pull across the line but the bounce gets big on him and he top edges it behind the keeper.
Back of a length ball close to off, Afghan defends it from the back foot to short mid-wicket. Called a no ball for overstepping.
FOUR! Well played this time! 150 up for Afghanistan as well. Short in length around middle, once again Asghar is down the track to ride the bounce and nails his pull shot in front of square leg.
Slower delivery, short and wide outside off, Afghan goes back and cracks it off his back foot but finds the cover fielder.
Risky shot! Afghan is getting restless. Gives the charge to the bowler, tries to heave a length ball across the line and just about manages to clear the square leg fielder. A couple taken.
Starts with a length ball close to off, Afghan goes nowhere with his footwork as he pushes it to mid on.

Quicker through the air this time, flat and very full on middle, Hashmatullah digs it out back to the bowler.
Gives this one some extra rip and gets it to spin back into the left-hander from outside off, Shahidi defends it from the back foot to point.
Floated and full around off, Shahidi presses forward and defends it back.

Burl goes short and wide outside off, Asghar cuts but finds the point fielder.

Knocks it down to long on and rotates the strike.
Short and wide outside off, Asghar cuts it through point for a couple of runs.

FOUR! This was coming! Afghan living up to his reputation and this is the reason why there is a long on in place. But still, the Afghanistan skipper goes for it, dances down the track and hammers it over the bowler's head. Not convincing, says Chakabva from behind the stumps.
