Who will operate from the other end? Blessing Muzarabani it is, 0/24 in 7 overs so far.
Tossed up and around off and middle, Shahidi keeps this one out solidly.
First runs of the afternoon session. Flighted on middle, eased through the mid on region for a single.
On middle, spinning away, down leg and it takes the pad and goes to the keeper.
He is not able to find his rhythm after the break. Bowls it on middle, the ball spins down the leg side as Ibrahim Zadran leaves.
Goes down the leg side again, left alone.
Slipped down the leg side, Zadran looks to work it on the leg side but fails to get any bat on this.
We are back for the second session of play. The batters for Afghanistan, Ibrahim Zadran and Hashmatullah Shahidi make their way out into the middle. Sikandar Raza to bowl now.
... Day 1, Session 2 ...

Ibrahim Zadran has just extended his form from the last Test match. With scores of 31 and 76 behind him, the opener looked confident and focused playing with a straight bat. He was solid in his defense but at the same time delightful whenever he chose to drive or pull. His presence will offer Afghanistan a sense of assurity as they will hope for a big knock from him in order to achieve a big first innings total. Do join us at 1210 local (0810 GMT) for the afternoon session.

All the three seamers for Zimbabwe bowled their hearts out but Victor Nyauchi impressed the most with his consistent lines and lengths. The other two pacers also fared well but it was a mixed-bag from them in terms of consistency. Sikandar Raza is the only spinner used by the touring team thus far and his match-up with Shahidi looked interesting. There isn't much on offer yet for the spinners but the off-spinner's angle for the left-hander looked threatening and that was mainly due to Hashmatullah's technique. This is one battle to look forward to!

A mixed first session for both teams! Zimbabwe started strongly by removing Javed Ahmadi early but then there was a solid partnership between Rahmat Shah and Ibrahim Zadran. They batted with great control and it appeared that the visitors are in for a long day on the field. But then, there was a moment of complete hara-kiri as Rahmat Shah got run out, responding late to the third run on offer. Since then, Hashmatullah Shahidi has partnered Ibrahim well and the duo has added 27 runs so far.
Last over before Lunch? Naahh...the umpires feel it's enough and the bails come off.
A bouncer to force the batsman down, Hashmatullah ducks to let this one through.
Short and outside off, Shahidi jumps a bit as he defends it down.
Gets on the front foot to a length ball and pushes it to covers.
Fuller length ball on middle, Zadran flicks it through backward square leg for a single.
Back of a length ball on top of off, Zadran is on the back foot again as he blocks it down safely.
Good length delivery outside off, Ibrahim hangs on the back foot and punches it to covers.
Slower through the air, full and around leg, Shahidi moves back and defends it with a vertical blade.
A bit short and on off, Shahidi cuts but finds the point fielder.
Extra flight on this one, it lands full on off, Ibrahim forces it down to long on for a single.
Loopy and full on off, Zadran is on the front foot in defense.
Fires a full ball down the leg side, Shahidi moves back and nudges it to square leg for one.
Full and floated on middle, Shahidi is forward in defense.
Raza vs Shahidi again! Something is cooking here...
Good length delivery on off, the batsman has just blocked that from his crease. Maiden!

Almost drags it on! Blessing delivers it on a fuller length wide outside off, Ibrahim is sucked into a drive there and he is lucky to inside edge it onto his pads. On another day, it would have gone onto the stumps.
A length ball on off, Zadran sticks on the back foot and presents a straight bat in defense.
Good length delivery is served in the zone outside off, too wide to make the batsman play. Zadran is smelling Lunch and is in no hurry to chase it.
Back of a length ball outside off, Ibrahim goes on the back foot and plays it down to point.
That is defended solidly off the front foot.
Blessing Muzarabani is back on. 0/23 in his 5 overs so far.
Tossed up ball outside off, Shahidi is forward as he pushes it with an angled bat past first slip. Looks for a run but Ibrahim screams 'waaaittttttt'.

A loud shout for an lbw! The umpire shakes his head, maybe bat first. A slider by Raza, around off and skidding back in, Shahidi lunges to defend with his bat and pad together. The Zimbabweans appeal but the umpire is not in agreement. He thinks it's bat first, we think that it's pad first but the impact is slightly outside off. Anyway, the batsman is safe.
Mishit, nearly a drag on! Full and floated around off, Shahidi walks down the track for a big heave across the line but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Flatter off spinner, slightly on the shorter side, Ibrahim punches it towards mid on for a run.
Raza goes short and bowls it on middle, Shahid pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run. Poor bowling by Sikandar.
Mid on drops back.
FOUR! Smashed down the ground! Full and flighted on middle, Shahidi attacks the line and blasts it down to long on for a boundary.
Raza has six balls to bowl to Shahidi. A slip in place along with a silly point...
Fullish and outside off, Ibrahim drives but straight to mid off.
That is defended solidly off the front foot.
Tiripano mixes his length to cut down the monotony, a bouncer around middle and leg, Zadran moves away from the line. Called a WIDE for height.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it to covers. Still not able to find the gaps, IZ.
A length ball on middle, Zadran defends it from the back foot and it takes the inner half before going to the right of mid on.
Once again the length is on the fuller side but the line is on middle and leg, Ibrahim plays an on drive but once more finds the fielder.
Pitches it full and wide outside off, Ibrahim drives but fails to beat the cover fielder.
Tossed up ball on off, fuller in length, this time Shahidi covers the movement and defends it well.
Edged but safe! Extra flight and it lands full on off, Shahidi draws forward in defense but it spins away to take the outside edge. Rolls to point.
Raza drags his length short on middle, Zadran goes on the back foot and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Loopy and full around off, Ibrahim plays for the non-existent spin there and edges it with his defensive bat to cover-point.
Fuller in length on middle, flicked on the leg side to mid-wicket.
Floated off spinner landing full around off, Ibrahim defends it off his front foot.

A cracking yorker, swinging back in from around off, Shahidi has his bat down in time as he digs it out from the bottom edge. Immediately turns back to see if the ball is heading for the stumps or not but it's rolling away wide. An excellent finish to the over by Donald.
Angling away from the batsman outside off, Shahidi opens the face of his bat and pushes it to point.
Fuller in length and wide outside off, Shahidi drives it through the line and the cover fielder fails to stop with a dive. The point fielder chases it down and saves two runs for his team.
Fuller in length and on middle and off, Shahidi defends it close to his body. Nice and compact.
Short and wide outside off, Zadran slaps it through covers and the deep point fielder moves across to his left to stop the ball. A single taken.
Two slips in place. Point drops back.
Good length ball on off, angling in, Ibrahim stands his ground, brings down a straight bat and pushes it to mid on.
Slower through the air, full and flighted on middle and off, Shahidi is on the back foot as he defends it back.
A touch short and on off, Shahidi goes deep inside the crease and plays the square cut. Finds point.
Bowls it full and around leg, Shahidi helps it past short leg.
Floated and full on off, Shahidi is forward in defense.
Slightly short this time, around off, Zadran goes on the back foot and turns it in the gap at mid-wicket for a run.
Presses forward to a full ball and presents a straight defensive bat to keep it out.
Good length ball drifting down the leg side, it's nudged behind square leg and Zadran retains strike with a single.
Fuller in length on middle, Zadran flicks it through the gap between mid-wicket and square leg for a couple of runs.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Ibrahim punches but finds the cover fielder.
Some movement in the air as Tiripano attacks the stumps with a fuller length ball, Ibrahim covers everything and pushes it down to mid on.
Tickles a full ball in the gap past the mid-wicket fielder for a couple of runs.
Full and angling in from around off, Ibrahim works it off his pads to mid-wicket.
Floated one, landing full around leg, Shahidi defends it with a straight blade.
Floated and full on middle, Shahidi brings down a straight bat and pushes it to mid on.
Full and flighted on middle, it's helped wide of mid-wicket for a run.
That is defended solidly off the front foot.
Umpire's referral. It's for a caught and bowled decision. They just want to check whether the catch is taken cleanly or not.

GRASSED! A tossed up delivery, landing full and around off, Ibrahim goes hard at it but it takes the inside part of the bat and goes uppishly back to the bowler. Raza gathers a low catch and is claiming it. The two umpires get together before referring it upstairs. One replay is enough to find out that the catch is not clean and the ball has touched the ground. Zadran survives.
Flighted and full on middle, Ibrahim drives it down and Raza deflects it wide of mid-wicket. Zadran wants a run but it's turned down by his partner.
Tiripano comes from 'round the wicket and angles in a full ball on off, Hashmatullah defends it solidly from the front foot.
Close to off, on a length and angling away, Shahidi defends it near his body and keeps it out off the outer half.
FOUR! Streaky! Full and outside off, once again Shahidi is lured into the drive and he slices it off the outer half past backward point for a boundary.
Drives this time! Full and outside off, Shahidi drives it with the elegance of a left-hander but fails to beat the cover fielder. Zimbabwe won't mind him driving with two slips in place.
Full and angling away from the left-hander, Shahidi doesn't chase this time.
Full length ball on middle, Zadran works it off his pads through backward square leg for a run.
Knocks a full ball down to long on for a single.
Floated and full on off, Zadran tries to defend but it takes the inside edge and rolls to mid-wicket.
Fuller and flatter on off, Ibrahim goes hard at it and plays it back to the bowler off the inner half of his blade.
Fuller and wide outside off, Ibrahim drives but finds the cover fielder.
Loopy and full on off, once again Zadran is forward in defense.
Flighted full ball on off, defended back off the front foot.
Time for some spin now! There is a left-hander in the middle so Sikandar Raza is the first of the four spinners to roll his arm.
Flashy, too flashy! Full and wide outside off, Shahidi goes for a booming drive but fails to connect.
On middle and off, it's blocked from the crease.
The batsman has just watchfully blocked this out.
The new batsman has arrived. It's Hashmatullah Shahidi.
Good length delivery on off, defended from the back foot.

OUT! Rahmat Shah is run out! Absolutely against the run of play and this is a terrible miscommunication. Back of a length delivery outside off, Ibrahim packs a punch through covers and they take a couple of runs. Zadran wants the third one also but Rahmat is late to take off. The throw comes to the keeper who jumps to collect it and then breaks the stumps in a flash. Nothing but hara-kiri. The replays find Rahmat short and he is near the exit point even before the third umpire has announced his verdict. A very disappointing end to a promising stand.
Terrible miscommunication. There is a run out appeal against Rahmat Shah. Referred upstairs...
Good length ball on middle, angling in, Zadran helps it off his pads to mid-wicket.

Drinks break. A good positive first hour for Afghanistan despite losing an early wicket. Rahmat Shah and Ibrahim Zadran have looked in control and have formed a strong alliance already. It is appearing to be a beautiful strip to bat on and let's see how it behaves when the spinners bowl.
Very full again, on middle, it's worked across the line but cannot find the gap at mid on.
Very full and on middle, Shah digs it out back past the bowler and the mid on fielder makes the stop.
Nicely played! Rahmat stands back to a shortish ball and steers it through the gap between point and cover-point. Two runs taken.
Goes full this time and bowls it around off, Shah is forward with a big stride in defense.
Victor uts down on his length and delivers a shorter one outside off, Rahmat cuts it from the back foot but finds point.
Serves a fuller length ball on off, it's defended off the front foot to the off side.
Victor Nyauchi into his 7th over now...
Lands it on a length around off, shaping in a bit, Ibrahim defends it from the back foot.
Good length ball on off, defended from the back foot.
FOUR! Easy pickings! A low full toss on middle, Ibrahim shows the full face of the bat and unveils a lovely straight drive for a boundary. 50 up for Afghanistan!
Angles in a full ball into the batsman from outside off, Ibrahim allows it to come to him and then blocks it to the off side.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and blocks a length ball from the crease.
Fuller length ball on off, Ibrahim brings the full face of the bat as he defends it to mid on.
Slower delivery, full and angling in, Shah does well to defend it towards mid on. Maybe, that ball held up slightly too on the batsman.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, Rahmat shoulders arms.
On a length and outside off, Rahmat keeps it out safely to covers.
The short leg fielder has moved back slightly and is standing a lot squarer too.
Good length delivery outside off, Rahmat stays back and defends it down to the right of gully.
Fuller in length again, on middle and leg, it's flicked past short leg and the square leg fielder makes the stop.
Fuller in length on middle, some visible movement, Shah defends it towards mid on.
Tries to tempt the batsman with a short and wide delivery outside off, Ibrahim shows a lot of restrain as he leaves it alone.
The line shifts slightly to middle and it's good enough for Rahmat to flick it in the gap at mid-wicket. A single taken.
Full and on middle, angling in, once again Rahmat brings down a straight bat as he defensively pushes it to mid on.
Good length ball on off, angling in, Shah meets it with a straight bat and blocks.
Fuller in length and outside off, Rahmat drives it off the front foot to mid off.
A gentle loosener, on a shortish length and wide outside off, Shah allows it through.
Five overs each to both the seamers who started the innings and now there is a bowling change. Donald Tiripano to have a go now.

'CATCH' is the shout again, but it has hurried past short leg. Shortish ball on middle and leg, Rahmat works it off his pads and once again it's a bit uppish. Goes past short leg in a jiffy for a single. 47/1 in 10 overs!
Back of a length ball on off, Rahmat stays back and plays it down to gully.

FOUR! The bowler manages to deceive the batsman there but the end result is a boundary. A low dipping full toss on middle and off, maybe an attempted yorker, Shah is deceived but does well to play at it with a straight drive. Hits it aerially but over the umpire at the other end and the mid on fielder has no chance.
Fuller in length on middle and off, Shah defends it solidly back to the bowler.

A shade uppish but safe! Too full and drifting down the leg side, Shah flicks it past short leg for a couple of runs. Maybe, the fielder under the lid needs to stand a bit deep if the plan is to catch a mistimed flick shot.
Fuller in length around off, Shah defends it off his front foot to covers.
A short leg in place as Victor Nyauchi gets ready to bowl his fifth over. Only one slip present now along with a gully as Zimbabwe are packing the cover region.
Fractionally short and wide outside off, Zadran goes on the back foot and plays it to point.
Fullish around off, Ibrahim drives it with the angle of the bowler to mid on.
Good length ball on middle, defended from the back foot to mid-wicket.

Well stopped but still a run! Fuller in length on middle, Rahmat drives it past his partner at the other end and the mid on fielder runs across to make a diving stop. He doesn't do that cleanly though and the batsmen steal a single.
Serves it full and on off, Rahmat drives it back to the bowler.
A length delivery in the region outside off, Shah allows it through to the keeper.
Good length ball close to off, Ibrahim remains on the back foot as he blocks it back.
Better from Victor! Fuller and on off, Ibrahim gets forward and defends it with gentle hands to point.
FOUR! Don't bother running! Short in length around off, Zadran swivels on the back foot and nails his pull shot in front of square leg for a boundary. Crisp.
Margin of error is minimum here. Victor bowls it on a length around middle and leg, Rahmat eases it down to fine leg for a run.
Action replay of the last delivery, once again Shah has defended it from the inner half to mid-wicket.
Pitches it up and around off, getting it to move back in a shade, Rahmat is forward to defend and he does so from the inside half of the bat.
Uses the angle of the bowler and works a length delivery in front of square leg. Finds the fielder.
On a length and outside off, Ibrahim drives it on the up and to the left of mid off. Screams a loud no though as his partner shows interest in a single.
Back of a length ball on off, shaping back in, Ibrahim goes on the back foot and defends it to mid on.
Pitches it up and outside off, Zadran drives it past the bowler but there is mid off present.
FOUR! Edgy but soft hands are the key. A length delivery outside off, Ibrahim gets back with an angled bat and it goes off the outer half past gully for a boundary.
Good length ball on off, defended solidly from the back foot.
Fullish and outside off, it's driven off the front foot to the cover fielder. So, placing that fielder really helped Zimbabwe in this over. A maiden!
On a length and outside off, Rahmat taps it down off the front foot to covers. Takes a few steps forward but there is no single on offer.
Once again the bowler lands it full and around off, Shah is forward as he defensively pushes it to covers.
Full and close to off, good lines from Victor Nyauchi, Rahmat pushes it to covers.
Full and angling in from around off, Rahmat is solidly behind the line in defense. One slip has moved out to covers and now there are two slip fielders left along with a gully.
A length ball on middle and leg, Shah works it off his pads to mid-wicket.
Good length ball on off, Zadran stays back to use the angle of the bowler and helps it to mid-wicket. 8 runs coming off this over as well from Blessing Muzarabani!

A bit fuller in length and outside off, Ibrahim drives it on the up and picks the gap at covers. They complete the single, some confusion over the second but as soon as the fielder fumbles, they take the second run as well.
On a length and outside off, Zadran leaves it and it shoots up as it reaches the keeper. Chakabva collects the ball over his head.
Good length ball on off, Ibrahim defends it back from the crease.
Finding the gaps with aplomb! Fuller in length and outside off, Rahmat strides forward, doesn't try to hit it hard, just times his shot through the gap at covers for another three runs.
Fuller length delivery sliding down the leg side, Ibrahim flicks it in front of square leg and bags three runs. Runs are coming quite easily for the Afghans.
Fractionally short and outside off, Shah eases himself on the back foot and punches it through covers for a couple of runs.
The batsman has just watchfully blocked this out.
Angles a length ball on off, Shah goes back with a straight bat in defense.
Bringing the batsman forward with his fuller length around off, Shah defends it to the off side.
Bowls it a good channel outside off, Shah pushes at it but the ball holds its line and takes the edge. Doesn't carry to gully.
Lands it on a length close to off, Shah fails to defend it from the front foot as there is extra bounce. He is pinged high on the pads.
Pitches it up and around off, shaping in, it's defended watchfully off the front foot by Ibrahim. A couple of boundaries from this over!

FOUR! Airborne stroke but it's in the gap! Full and angling down the leg side, the movement takes it further down and Zadran clips it off his pads. Doesn't bother to keep it down and collects a boundary at deep mid-wicket. Very wristy!
Short in length and close to off, it's bowled from wide of the crease, Ibrahim leans back and allows it through to the keeper.
Full and on middle, a hint of movement, Ibrahim drives it down to mid on.
The bowler is forced to alter his length after the last shot, it's shortish and outside off, Zadran goes on the back foot in defense.
FOUR! Yet another excellent shot, this time from the bat of Ibrahim. He takes his front leg forward to a full ball outside off and unfurls a lovely off drive for a boundary. Good to watch!

FOUR! Silken drive! You can straightaway see the difference in class. Ahmadi was driving without much conviction and here is Rahmat Shah, putting in all the elegance behind his cover drive. Everything right about that shot. A boundary results.
Good length ball close to off, Shah goes back to defend and does so with the inner half of his bat.
Pitches it up and around off, Rahmat drives it confidently down towards mid off, slight midfield and he opens his account with a couple of runs.
Rahmat Shah is the new batsman at number 3.

OUT! Caught in the slips! Javed Ahmadi was flirting with fire and has eventually thrown away his wicket. Nyauchi knows that the batsman is trying to be too flashy and he just calmly serves a full ball wide outside off, Javed attempts for yet another booming drive but this time he edges it straight into the hands of Sean Williams at third slip. Early breakthrough for Zimbabwe and they are ecstatic.
Beaten all ends up! Lovely delivery, it's full and around off, Javed tries to drive again but the ball nips away slightly to beat the outside edge.
STREAKY FOUR! Fuller in length and wide outside off, Ahmadi chases it as he attempts to drive but it takes the outside edge and flies over the leaping gully fielder for a boundary.
Who will bowl from the other end? Victor Nyauchi to steam in...
This one comes back into the batsman with the angle, Zadran solidly covers the line and defends.
Beaten! Some extra bounce there as a length ball holds its line outside off, Ibrahim needlessly pushes inside the line and misses.
Afghanistan are away in an edgy manner. Length delivery outside off, Ibrahim drives it off the outer half and it races past the point fielder for a couple of runs.
Giving nothing away, no blessings for the batsman from Muzarabani. On and around off, a length delivery, it's defended off the back foot.
Back of a length delivery around off, the batsman goes on the back foot and plays it down to point.
Starts with a good length ball on off, Ibrahim defends it solidly to covers.

It's time to get underway! Zimbabwe are in a huddle. Aleem Dar and Ahmed Shah Pakteen are the onfield umpires. Out come the Afghanistan openers - Javed Ahmadi and Ibrahim Zadran. Blessing Muzarabani, playing his 3rd Test, is ready to run in. Three slips and a gully in place. Let's play...

Sean Williams, captain of Zimbabwe, says that he would have liked to bat first as well but feels that these are the challenges they need to deal with. Feels that there will be some turn on offer and he is backing his boys to deliver the goods again. Informs that they are going unchanged.

Asghar Afghan, captain of Afghanistan, says that this wicket is different, it's looking good and that's why they want to bat first. Tells that today is a new game and they are positive about this one. Confirms that there are five changes with Rashid Khan coming in and there are a few debutants as well in the XI.

Pitch report - Tino Mawoyo inspects the conditions and shares the temperature is fine and a nice breeze is blowing across the stadium. Tells that there is barely any grass on the surface, unlike the last Test match. Points out a couple of areas where there are cracks already which means that underneath, it's very, very dry.

Zimbabwe (Unchanged Playing XI) - Kevin Kasuza, Prince Masvaure, Sean Williams (C), Wesley Madhevere, Tarisai Musakanda, Sikandar Raza, Ryan Burl, Regis Chakabva (WK), Donald Tiripano, Blessing Muzarabani, Victor Nyauchi.

Afghanistan (Playing XI) - Javed Ahmadi (In for Abdul Malik), Ibrahim Zadran, Rahmat Shah, Hashmatullah Shahidi, Nasir Jamal (In for Munir Ahmad), Asghar Afghan (C), Afsar Zazai (WK), Rashid Khan (In for Zahir Khan), Amir Hamza, Shahidullah Kamal (In for Yamin Ahmadzai), Sayed Shirzad (In for Abdul Wasi).
Toss - Afghanistan have won the toss and elected to bat. As many as five changes for them while Zimbabwe have retained their winning XI.

A 2-day Test match created a massive uproar at a place 1856 km away from Abu Dhabi but there was no such reaction here or anywhere regarding the first Test ending in just two days. When that happens, you know that the teams involved are not attracting enough attention, so you need to do something extraordinary to force the cricket world to stop and take notice. Are Afghanistan and Zimbabwe ready to do that?

Hello and welcome everyone! Let's switch our attention again to this Test series involving less-fancied teams, Afghanistan and Zimbabwe. Away from the gaze and scrutiny of the harsh and restless world, these two teams face each other again with the African team eyeing a rarest of rare clean sweep for them in Tests while Afghanistan would be eager to prove their Test credentials by avenging the last embarrassing loss. Thank you for joining us as we warm up to bring you the entire coverage from Day 1 of the second Test match.
